title: LRU Cache for Map Tiles
hints: You need O(1) lookup (hash map) AND O(1) reordering (doubly linked list).
Keep `std::list<std::pair<Key, Value>> items_` with the most recent at the front, and `std::unordered_map<Key, typename std::list<...>::iterator> index_`.
On a hit, `items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it)` moves the node to the front in O(1) without invalidating any iterator.
put on a full cache: the victim is `items_.back()`. Erase its key from `index_` FIRST (you need the key), then `pop_back()`.
